title: Kenapa Bitcoin cuma ada 21 juta?
summary: Pasokan Bitcoin dibatasi oleh aturan protokol, bukan oleh satu perusahaan. Ini cara batas 21 juta bekerja.
key_points: Jumlah maksimum Bitcoin yang bisa ada adalah 21 juta koin. Batas ini tertanam di aturan protokol Bitcoin.
Koin baru lahir sebagai hadiah blok untuk miner. Hadiah itu dipotong separuh setiap 210.000 blok (halving).
Karena hadiah terus mengecil, penambahan koin makin lambat. Koin terakhir diperkirakan selesai ditambang sekitar tahun 2140.
body: Bitcoin tidak punya bank sentral yang bisa mencetak uang sesuka hati. Jadwal penerbitan koinnya ditentukan aturan di dalam software jaringan, dan aturan itu membatasi total pasokan di 21 juta BTC.

Koin baru dibuat lewat hadiah blok (block subsidy) untuk miner yang berhasil menambahkan blok ke blockchain. Hadiah ini mulai dari 50 BTC per blok dan dipotong separuh setiap 210.000 blok, kira-kira tiap empat tahun. Deret pemotongan yang terus mengecil inilah yang membuat total pasokan mendekati, tetapi tidak pernah melewati, 21 juta.
Artinya sebagian besar Bitcoin sudah beredar, sedangkan sisanya keluar makin pelan. Menurut Bitcoin Wiki, koin terakhir diperkirakan ditambang sekitar tahun 2140.
analysis: Pasokan yang terbatas sering dipakai sebagai argumen bahwa Bitcoin 'langka'. Itu penjelasan tentang desain, bukan jaminan harga naik. Harga tetap ditentukan permintaan dan penawaran di pasar.

title_en: Why will there only ever be 21 million Bitcoin?
summary_en: Bitcoin's supply is capped by protocol rules, not by a single company. Here is how the 21 million cap works.
key_points_en: The maximum number of Bitcoin that can exist is 21 million coins. The cap is built into Bitcoin's protocol rules.
New coins are created as block rewards for miners. The reward is cut in half every 210,000 blocks (the halving).
Because the reward keeps shrinking, new coins arrive more and more slowly. The last coin is expected to be mined around 2140.
body_en: Bitcoin has no central bank that can print money at will. Its issuance schedule is set by rules in the network software, and those rules cap total supply at 21 million BTC.

New coins are created through the block reward (block subsidy) for miners who successfully add a block to the blockchain. The reward started at 50 BTC per block and is cut in half every 210,000 blocks, roughly every four years. This ever-shrinking series is what makes total supply approach, but never exceed, 21 million.
This means most Bitcoin is already in circulation, while the rest is released more and more slowly. According to the Bitcoin Wiki, the last coin is expected to be mined around 2140.
analysis_en: Limited supply is often used to argue that Bitcoin is 'scarce'. That explains the design, not a guarantee that the price will rise. The price is still set by supply and demand in the market.

title: Apa itu halving Bitcoin?
summary: Halving memotong hadiah blok Bitcoin separuh setiap 210.000 blok. Ini riwayat dan jadwal berikutnya.
key_points: Halving adalah pemotongan hadiah blok untuk miner menjadi separuh, terjadi setiap 210.000 blok (sekitar empat tahun).
Hadiah blok turun dari 50 BTC (2009) ke 25 (2012), 12,5 (2016), 6,25 (2020), dan 3,125 BTC (April 2024).
Halving berikutnya terjadi di blok 1.050.000 dan menurunkan hadiah ke 1,5625 BTC. Perkiraan waktunya sekitar 2028, bergantung pada kecepatan pembuatan blok.
body: Setiap kali miner menambahkan satu blok baru, jaringan Bitcoin memberi hadiah berupa koin baru. Besarnya hadiah itu tidak tetap: tiap 210.000 blok, hadiahnya dipotong separuh. Peristiwa ini disebut halving.

Karena rata-rata satu blok dibuat tiap sekitar 10 menit, 210.000 blok setara kira-kira empat tahun. Halving terakhir terjadi pada April 2024 dan menurunkan hadiah blok menjadi 3,125 BTC. Per November 2026, hadiah itu masih berlaku.
Halving berikutnya dijadwalkan di blok 1.050.000. Tanggal pastinya tidak bisa dipastikan sekarang karena bergantung pada waktu pembuatan blok, tetapi perkiraannya sekitar 2028.
analysis: Sebagian orang mengaitkan halving dengan kenaikan harga. Hubungan itu hanya pola historis yang ditafsirkan, bukan hukum pasar, dan tidak ada jaminan akan terulang.

summary_en: The halving cuts Bitcoin's block reward in half every 210,000 blocks. Here is its history and the next date.
key_points_en: The halving cuts the miners' block reward in half and happens every 210,000 blocks (about four years).
The block reward fell from 50 BTC (2009) to 25 (2012), 12.5 (2016), 6.25 (2020), and 3.125 BTC (April 2024).
The next halving happens at block 1,050,000 and cuts the reward to 1.5625 BTC. It is expected around 2028, depending on how fast blocks are produced.
body_en: Every time a miner adds a new block, the Bitcoin network pays a reward in new coins. The size of that reward is not fixed: every 210,000 blocks it is cut in half. This event is called the halving.

Because a block is produced on average about every 10 minutes, 210,000 blocks is roughly four years. The last halving took place in April 2024 and cut the block reward to 3.125 BTC. As of November 2026, that reward still applies.
The next halving is scheduled at block 1,050,000. The exact date cannot be known yet because it depends on block times, but it is expected around 2028.
analysis_en: Some people link the halving to price increases. That link is only an interpreted historical pattern, not a market law, and there is no guarantee it will repeat.

title: Stablecoin: apa itu, jenisnya, dan risikonya
summary: Stablecoin dirancang menjaga nilai stabil, umumnya dipatok ke dolar AS. Stabil bukan berarti bebas risiko.
key_points: Stablecoin adalah aset kripto yang dirancang mempertahankan nilai tetap, paling umum 1 koin = 1 dolar AS.
Ada yang didukung cadangan (uang tunai, surat utang), ada yang didukung aset kripto, dan ada yang algoritmik.
Risiko utamanya: kehilangan patokan (depeg), transparansi cadangan, dan risiko penerbit atau regulasi.
body: Harga aset kripto biasa bisa naik turun tajam. Stablecoin dibuat untuk mengurangi masalah itu: nilainya dipatok ke aset lain, paling sering dolar AS, supaya bisa dipakai untuk transaksi atau sebagai tempat parkir dana di dalam ekosistem kripto.

Jenis yang umum: (1) didukung cadangan, di mana penerbit menyimpan uang tunai atau aset likuid sebagai jaminan, seperti Tether (USDT); (2) didukung aset kripto, dengan jaminan berupa kripto lain; (3) algoritmik, yang mengandalkan mekanisme kode tanpa cadangan penuh. TerraUST, stablecoin algoritmik, kehilangan patokannya pada Mei 2022.

Risikonya: patokan bisa lepas saat pasar panik, cadangan bisa kurang transparan, dan penerbit bisa terkena masalah hukum atau regulasi. Karena itu laporan cadangan penting dibaca, misalnya dalam berita laba Tether Q3 2026 di COIN BRO, dengan catatan bahwa laporan tersebut berupa atestasi dan bukan audit penuh.
analysis: Label 'stabil' menjelaskan tujuan desain, bukan jaminan hasil. Menilai stablecoin berarti menilai siapa penerbitnya dan apa isi cadangannya.

title_en: Stablecoins: what they are, the types, and the risks
summary_en: Stablecoins are designed to keep a stable value, usually pegged to the US dollar. Stable does not mean risk-free.
key_points_en: A stablecoin is a crypto asset designed to keep a fixed value, most commonly 1 coin = 1 US dollar.
Some are backed by reserves (cash, government debt), some by crypto assets, and some are algorithmic.
The main risks: losing the peg (depeg), reserve transparency, and issuer or regulatory risk.
body_en: Ordinary crypto prices can swing sharply. Stablecoins are designed to reduce that problem: their value is pegged to another asset, most often the US dollar, so they can be used for transactions or as a place to park funds inside the crypto ecosystem.

Common types: (1) reserve-backed, where the issuer holds cash or liquid assets as collateral, such as Tether (USDT); (2) crypto-backed, with other crypto as collateral; (3) algorithmic, relying on code mechanisms without full reserves. TerraUST, an algorithmic stablecoin, lost its peg in May 2022.

The risks: the peg can break when markets panic, reserves can lack transparency, and the issuer can face legal or regulatory trouble. That is why reserve reports are worth reading, for example in COIN BRO's story on Tether's Q3 2026 profit, keeping in mind that the report is an attestation and not a full audit.
analysis_en: The 'stable' label describes the design goal, not a guaranteed outcome. Judging a stablecoin means judging who issues it and what its reserves hold.

title: Hot wallet vs cold wallet: bedanya apa?
summary: Hot wallet terhubung ke internet, cold wallet disimpan offline. Masing-masing punya risiko sendiri.
key_points: Hot wallet terhubung ke internet (aplikasi, ekstensi browser, akun exchange): praktis, tetapi lebih terbuka terhadap malware dan phishing.
Cold wallet menyimpan kunci secara offline (misalnya hardware wallet): lebih tahan serangan online.
Cold wallet tetap berisiko jika seed phrase hilang atau perangkat dibeli dari sumber tidak resmi.
body: Wallet kripto pada dasarnya menjaga kunci privat yang dipakai untuk mengakses dana. Perbedaan hot dan cold ada pada apakah kunci itu pernah menyentuh perangkat yang online.

Hot wallet cocok untuk dana kecil yang sering dipakai, karena cepat dan mudah. Konsekuensinya, kuncinya berada di perangkat yang terhubung ke internet, sehingga malware, situs phishing, atau akun yang dibobol bisa menguras dana.

Cold wallet menyimpan kunci di perangkat yang tidak online, sehingga lebih sulit diserang dari jauh. Tetapi tanggung jawab berpindah ke pemilik: seed phrase harus disimpan offline dan jangan dibagikan ke siapa pun. Beli perangkat hanya dari toko resmi produsen, seperti kasus Trezor Safe 5 di Tokopedia yang dibahas COIN BRO.

title_en: Hot wallet vs cold wallet: what's the difference?
summary_en: A hot wallet is connected to the internet, a cold wallet is kept offline. Each has its own risks.
key_points_en: A hot wallet is connected to the internet (apps, browser extensions, exchange accounts): convenient, but more exposed to malware and phishing.
A cold wallet keeps keys offline (for example a hardware wallet): more resistant to online attacks.
A cold wallet is still at risk if the seed phrase is lost or the device was bought from an unofficial source.
body_en: A crypto wallet basically guards the private keys used to access funds. The difference between hot and cold is whether those keys ever touch an online device.

A hot wallet suits small amounts used often, because it is fast and easy. The trade-off is that the keys sit on an internet-connected device, so malware, phishing sites or a hacked account can drain the funds.

A cold wallet keeps keys on a device that is not online, making remote attacks harder. But responsibility shifts to the owner: the seed phrase must be stored offline and never shared with anyone. Only buy devices from the manufacturer's official store, as shown by the Trezor Safe 5 case on Tokopedia covered by COIN BRO.

title: Sejarah: 5 tahun lalu, Bitcoin cetak rekor dekat US$69.000 di hari inflasi AS tembus 6,2%
summary: Pada 10 November 2021, Bitcoin mencetak rekor tertinggi saat itu di sekitar US$68.950, tak lama setelah data inflasi AS keluar di level tertinggi sejak 1990. Setahun kemudian, harganya jatuh ke US$15.480. Ini kisahnya, dan kenapa hari ini terasa mirip.
key_points: Pada 10 November 2021, Bitcoin naik ke rekor US$68.950 tak lama setelah rilis data inflasi konsumen (CPI) AS pukul 13.30 UTC, menurut CoinDesk.
CPI AS Oktober 2021 naik 6,2% secara tahunan, tercepat sejak 1990. Inflasi inti naik 4,6%, tertinggi sejak Agustus 1991.
Saat itu banyak investor memakai Bitcoin dan emas sebagai "lindung nilai inflasi". Emas juga naik ke level tertinggi lima bulan di US$1.853.
Pada 16 Maret 2022, The Fed mulai menaikkan suku bunga. Pada November 2022, setelah runtuhnya FTX, Bitcoin jatuh ke US$15.480, terendah sejak November 2020.
Lima tahun kemudian, 10 November 2026, pasar kembali menunggu data CPI AS di jam yang sama, 13.30 UTC, dengan Bitcoin di sekitar US$74.000-an.
body: Tanggal 10 November punya tempat khusus dalam sejarah Bitcoin. Pada hari itu di tahun 2021, Departemen Tenaga Kerja AS merilis data inflasi konsumen (CPI) bulan Oktober pukul 08.30 waktu New York, atau 13.30 UTC (21.30 WITA). Angkanya mengejutkan: harga konsumen naik 6,2% dibanding setahun sebelumnya, laju tercepat sejak 1990. Inflasi inti, yang tidak menghitung makanan dan energi, naik 4,6%, tertinggi sejak Agustus 1991. Secara bulanan, CPI naik 0,9%, menurut CNBC.

Pasar langsung bereaksi. Menurut CoinDesk, harga Bitcoin naik hampir US$3.000 setelah rilis data itu dan mencetak rekor baru US$68.950. Emas, aset lindung nilai tradisional, juga menembus level tertinggi lima bulan di US$1.853. CNBC melaporkan investor beralih ke aset yang dianggap tahan inflasi, baik yang lama seperti emas maupun yang baru seperti Bitcoin.

Narasinya saat itu sederhana: pasokan Bitcoin dibatasi 21 juta koin, jadi ia dianggap pelindung nilai ketika bank sentral mencetak uang dan inflasi naik. Bitcoin juga baru saja naik 40% di bulan Oktober 2021. Menurut CoinDesk, narasi populer saat itu mengaitkan reli tersebut dengan peluncuran ETF berjangka Bitcoin pertama di AS, sementara analis JPMorgan mengaitkannya dengan naiknya ekspektasi inflasi.

Tapi inflasi yang tinggi juga berarti The Fed harus bertindak. Pada 16 Maret 2022, The Fed menaikkan suku bunga acuan ke kisaran 0,25%-0,50% dan memberi sinyal kenaikan lanjutan. Uang murah yang ikut mendorong reli 2021 mulai ditarik.

Tahun 2022 kemudian menjadi "crypto winter". Pada November 2022, bursa FTX runtuh. CoinDesk melaporkan Bitcoin jatuh ke bawah US$16.000 setelah Binance membatalkan rencana mengambil alih FTX pada 9 November, dan FTX mengajukan kebangkrutan dua hari kemudian. Pada 21 November 2022, menurut Kitco News, Bitcoin menyentuh US$15.480, harga terendah sejak November 2020. Berdasarkan hitungan COIN BRO, itu sekitar 78% di bawah rekor setahun sebelumnya.

Lima tahun setelah rekor itu, polanya terasa akrab. Malam ini, 10 November 2026, data CPI AS kembali dirilis pukul 13.30 UTC (21.30 WITA). Bedanya, kali ini The Fed sedang membahas kenaikan suku bunga di bulan Desember, dan Bitcoin diperdagangkan di sekitar US$74.450 menurut crypto.news. Berdasarkan hitungan COIN BRO, itu hanya sekitar 8% di atas rekor November 2021.
why_it_matters: Kisah 2021-2022 menunjukkan bahwa data inflasi bisa menggerakkan Bitcoin ke dua arah. Inflasi tinggi sempat mendorong harga ke rekor, tetapi respons bank sentral berupa suku bunga lebih tinggi kemudian ikut menekan pasar crypto.
tips: Narasi "lindung nilai inflasi" tidak selalu berlaku dalam jangka pendek. Arah suku bunga juga sangat berpengaruh.
Rekor harga bisa diikuti penurunan besar. Hindari memakai uang yang kamu butuhkan dalam waktu dekat untuk aset berisiko tinggi.
Simpan aset di platform yang terdaftar dan diawasi OJK, dan pahami risiko bursa, seperti yang terlihat dari kasus FTX.
analysis: Sejarah tidak selalu berulang dengan cara yang sama. Kondisi 2026 berbeda dari 2021, misalnya sudah ada ETF Bitcoin spot dan lebih banyak perusahaan yang memegang BTC. Perbandingan ini dibuat untuk konteks, bukan untuk memprediksi harga.

title_en: History: 5 years ago, Bitcoin set a record near US$69,000 on the day US inflation hit 6.2%
summary_en: On 10 November 2021, Bitcoin set its then-record high of about US$68,950, shortly after US inflation data came out at its highest level since 1990. A year later, its price fell to US$15,480. Here is the story, and why today feels similar.
key_points_en: On 10 November 2021, Bitcoin rose to a record US$68,950 shortly after the release of US consumer price index (CPI) data at 13:30 UTC, according to CoinDesk.
US CPI for October 2021 rose 6.2% year on year, the fastest since 1990. Core inflation rose 4.6%, the highest since August 1991.
At the time many investors used Bitcoin and gold as an "inflation hedge". Gold also rose to a five-month high of US$1,853.
On 16 March 2022, the Fed began raising interest rates. In November 2022, after the collapse of FTX, Bitcoin fell to US$15,480, its lowest since November 2020.
Five years later, on 10 November 2026, markets are again waiting for US CPI data at the same time, 13:30 UTC, with Bitcoin around the US$74,000 level.
body_en: 10 November holds a special place in Bitcoin's history. On that day in 2021, the US Labor Department released October consumer price index (CPI) data at 08:30 New York time, or 13:30 UTC (21:30 WITA). The figure was a shock: consumer prices rose 6.2% from a year earlier, the fastest pace since 1990. Core inflation, which excludes food and energy, rose 4.6%, the highest since August 1991. Month on month, CPI rose 0.9%, according to CNBC.

Markets reacted immediately. According to CoinDesk, the price of Bitcoin rose by nearly US$3,000 after the data release and set a new record of US$68,950. Gold, the traditional hedge, also broke through to a five-month high of US$1,853. CNBC reported that investors moved into assets seen as inflation-resistant, both old ones such as gold and new ones such as Bitcoin.

The narrative at the time was simple: Bitcoin's supply is capped at 21 million coins, so it was seen as a store of value when central banks print money and inflation rises. Bitcoin had also just rallied 40% in October 2021. According to CoinDesk, the popular narrative at the time linked that rally to the launch of the first US Bitcoin futures ETF, while JPMorgan analysts attributed it to rising inflation expectations.

But high inflation also meant the Fed had to act. On 16 March 2022, the Fed raised its policy rate to a range of 0.25%-0.50% and signaled further increases. The cheap money that had helped fuel the 2021 rally began to be withdrawn.

2022 then became a "crypto winter". In November 2022, the FTX exchange collapsed. CoinDesk reported that Bitcoin fell below US$16,000 after Binance backed out of a plan to acquire FTX on 9 November, and FTX filed for bankruptcy two days later. On 21 November 2022, according to Kitco News, Bitcoin touched US$15,480, its lowest price since November 2020. By COIN BRO's calculation, that was about 78% below the record set a year earlier.

Five years after that record, the pattern feels familiar. Tonight, 10 November 2026, US CPI data is again released at 13:30 UTC (21:30 WITA). The difference is that this time the Fed is discussing a rate hike in December, and Bitcoin is trading at around US$74,450 according to crypto.news. By COIN BRO's calculation, that is only about 8% above the November 2021 record.
why_en: The 2021-2022 story shows that inflation data can move Bitcoin in both directions. High inflation briefly pushed the price to a record, but the central bank's response in the form of higher interest rates then weighed on the crypto market.
tips_en: The "inflation hedge" narrative does not always hold in the short term. The direction of interest rates matters a lot too.
A record price can be followed by a big decline. Avoid using money you need in the near term for high-risk assets.
Keep assets on platforms registered with and supervised by OJK, and understand exchange risk, as the FTX case showed.
analysis_en: History does not always repeat in the same way. Conditions in 2026 differ from 2021; for example, spot Bitcoin ETFs now exist and more companies hold BTC. This comparison is made for context, not to predict prices.

title: Misteri: 1,1 juta Bitcoin milik Satoshi yang tak pernah bergerak, dan kenapa komputer kuantum ikut dibahas
summary: Pencipta Bitcoin, Satoshi Nakamoto, diperkirakan memegang sekitar 1,1 juta BTC yang tidak pernah dipindahkan sejak awal Bitcoin. Siapa Satoshi masih misteri. Kini koin-koin itu ikut dibahas dalam diskusi soal risiko komputer kuantum. Ini faktanya, dan mana yang masih teori.
key_points: FAKTA: Satoshi Nakamoto menerbitkan whitepaper Bitcoin pada 31 Oktober 2008 dan meluncurkan jaringan Bitcoin pada Januari 2009. Pesan terakhir yang diketahui adalah email tahun 2011 yang menyebut ia sudah "moved on to other things".
FAKTA: Riset peneliti Sergio Lerner (pola "Patoshi") memperkirakan Satoshi menambang sekitar 1,1 juta BTC di awal Bitcoin. Koin itu tidak pernah dipindahkan. Angka pastinya tetap perkiraan.
FAKTA: Pada Maret 2024, Pengadilan Tinggi London memutuskan Craig Wright bukan Satoshi Nakamoto.

FAKTA: Glassnode (10 Nov 2026) mencatat 7,12 juta BTC atau 35,4% suplai punya public key yang terlihat di blockchain, bagian yang secara teori bisa diincar komputer kuantum di masa depan. Koin era Satoshi termasuk di dalamnya.
TEORI: Banyak nama pernah diduga sebagai Satoshi, seperti Hal Finney, Nick Szabo, dan Adam Back. Semuanya membantah, dan tidak ada yang terbukti.
body: Pada 31 Oktober 2008, seseorang (atau sekelompok orang) dengan nama Satoshi Nakamoto menerbitkan whitepaper "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" di milis kriptografi. Pada 3 Januari 2009, blok pertama Bitcoin (genesis block) dibuat, dan di dalamnya tertulis judul berita surat kabar Inggris The Times: "Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks". Software Bitcoin versi 0.1 dirilis pada 9 Januari 2009.

Pada pertengahan 2010, Satoshi menyerahkan kendali repositori kode kepada pengembang Gavin Andresen, dan tetap aktif dalam pengembangan Bitcoin sampai Desember 2010. Pada 2011, dalam email kepada pengembang Mike Hearn, Satoshi menulis bahwa ia sudah "moved on to other things" (beralih ke hal lain). Setelah itu, tidak ada lagi kabar yang bisa dipastikan berasal darinya.

Bagaimana kita tahu Satoshi punya banyak Bitcoin? Pada 2013, peneliti keamanan Sergio Lerner menganalisis blok-blok awal Bitcoin dan menemukan pola unik pada cara satu penambang dominan bekerja, yang kemudian dikenal sebagai pola "Patoshi". Dari situ ia memperkirakan Satoshi menambang sekitar 1,1 juta BTC. Perkiraan lain menyebut kisaran 750.000 sampai 1,1 juta BTC. Koin-koin ini tidak pernah dipindahkan. Dengan harga Bitcoin sekitar US$73.000-74.000 pada 10 November 2026, menurut hitungan COIN BRO, 1,1 juta BTC bernilai sekitar US$80 miliar.

Siapa Satoshi? Ini bagian yang masih TEORI. Banyak nama pernah dikaitkan, antara lain kriptografer Hal Finney (meninggal 2014), Nick Szabo (pencetus konsep "bit gold"), dan Adam Back (penemu Hashcash, yang disebut dalam whitepaper Bitcoin). Ketiganya membantah. Pada 2014, majalah Newsweek menyebut Dorian Nakamoto, seorang insinyur di California, sebagai Satoshi; ia membantah dan klaim itu banyak dikritik. Sementara itu, Craig Wright dari Australia lama mengklaim dirinya Satoshi, tetapi pada Maret 2024 Pengadilan Tinggi London memutuskan ia bukan Satoshi dan bukan penulis whitepaper Bitcoin.

Kenapa koin Satoshi kini ikut dibahas soal komputer kuantum? Menurut Glassnode, koin bisa "terekspos" jika public key-nya sudah terlihat di blockchain. Komputer kuantum yang cukup kuat, yang belum ada saat ini, secara teori bisa memakai algoritma Shor untuk menurunkan private key dari public key. Koin-koin awal era Satoshi memakai format lama (P2PK) yang memperlihatkan public key sejak awal. Glassnode mencatat pada 10 November 2026 ada 7,12 juta BTC atau 35,4% suplai dengan public key terlihat, naik dari 6,04 juta BTC (30,2%) pada Mei 2026. Sebagian besar karena pemakaian ulang alamat (address reuse).

Para pengembang Bitcoin sudah membahas solusinya, misalnya draf BIP-360 yang mengusulkan format output baru. Namun ini masih draf dan belum ada keputusan. Untuk koin yang pemiliknya tidak aktif atau kuncinya hilang, termasuk kemungkinan koin Satoshi, koin itu tidak bisa dipindahkan ke format yang lebih aman kecuali ada perubahan protokol yang kemungkinan besar akan diperdebatkan.
why_it_matters: Koin Satoshi mewakili sekitar 5% dari total suplai maksimal 21 juta BTC. Jika suatu hari koin itu bergerak, baik karena pemiliknya aktif lagi atau karena serangan teknologi baru, pasar kemungkinan akan bereaksi besar. Karena itu misteri ini tetap relevan sampai sekarang.
tips: Hindari memakai ulang alamat Bitcoin yang sama. Menurut Glassnode, memindahkan koin ke alamat baru mengakhiri eksposur public key akibat address reuse.
Waspadai siapa pun yang mengaku Satoshi atau menjual "koin Satoshi". Klaim seperti ini sudah berkali-kali terbukti tidak benar.
Ancaman kuantum masih teori untuk saat ini. Jangan panik, tapi ikuti perkembangan dari sumber resmi pengembang Bitcoin.
analysis: Bagian fakta di artikel ini bersumber dari catatan publik, riset on-chain, dan putusan pengadilan. Bagian teori soal identitas Satoshi hanya dugaan yang belum pernah terbukti, dan semua yang disebut sudah membantah. Perkiraan 1,1 juta BTC juga bukan angka pasti.

title_en: Mystery: Satoshi's 1.1 million Bitcoin that have never moved, and why quantum computers come up
summary_en: Bitcoin's creator, Satoshi Nakamoto, is estimated to hold about 1.1 million BTC that have never been moved since Bitcoin's early days. Who Satoshi is remains a mystery. Now those coins are also part of the discussion about quantum computing risk. Here are the facts, and what is still theory.
key_points_en: FACT: Satoshi Nakamoto published the Bitcoin whitepaper on 31 October 2008 and launched the Bitcoin network in January 2009. The last known message is a 2011 email saying he had "moved on to other things".
FACT: Research by Sergio Lerner (the "Patoshi" pattern) estimates Satoshi mined about 1.1 million BTC in Bitcoin's early days. Those coins have never been moved. The exact figure remains an estimate.
FACT: In March 2024, London's High Court ruled that Craig Wright is not Satoshi Nakamoto.

FACT: Glassnode (10 Nov 2026) counted 7.12 million BTC, or 35.4% of supply, with public keys visible on the blockchain, the part a future quantum computer could theoretically target. Satoshi-era coins are among them.
THEORY: Many names have been suggested as Satoshi, such as Hal Finney, Nick Szabo and Adam Back. All have denied it, and none has been proven.
body_en: On 31 October 2008, a person (or group of people) using the name Satoshi Nakamoto published the whitepaper "Bitcoin: A Peer-to-Peer Electronic Cash System" on a cryptography mailing list. On 3 January 2009, Bitcoin's first block (the genesis block) was created, containing a headline from the British newspaper The Times: "Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks". Version 0.1 of the Bitcoin software was released on 9 January 2009.

In mid-2010, Satoshi handed control of the code repository to developer Gavin Andresen, and stayed active in Bitcoin's development until December 2010. In 2011, in an email to developer Mike Hearn, Satoshi wrote that he had "moved on to other things". After that, there was no further word that can be confirmed as coming from him.

How do we know Satoshi has a lot of Bitcoin? In 2013, security researcher Sergio Lerner analyzed Bitcoin's early blocks and found a unique pattern in how one dominant miner operated, later known as the "Patoshi" pattern. From this he estimated that Satoshi mined about 1.1 million BTC. Other estimates put it in a range of 750,000 to 1.1 million BTC. These coins have never been moved. With Bitcoin at around US$73,000-74,000 on 10 November 2026, by COIN BRO's calculation, 1.1 million BTC would be worth about US$80 billion.

Who is Satoshi? This part is still THEORY. Many names have been linked, including cryptographer Hal Finney (who died in 2014), Nick Szabo (who came up with the "bit gold" concept) and Adam Back (inventor of Hashcash, who is cited in the Bitcoin whitepaper). All three have denied it. In 2014, Newsweek magazine named Dorian Nakamoto, an engineer in California, as Satoshi; he denied it and the claim was widely criticized. Meanwhile, Australian Craig Wright long claimed to be Satoshi, but in March 2024 London's High Court ruled that he is not Satoshi and not the author of the Bitcoin whitepaper.

Why are Satoshi's coins now part of the quantum computing discussion? According to Glassnode, coins can be "exposed" if their public key is already visible on the blockchain. A sufficiently powerful quantum computer, which does not exist today, could in theory use Shor's algorithm to derive a private key from a public key. Early Satoshi-era coins use an old format (P2PK) that reveals the public key from the start. Glassnode counted 7.12 million BTC, or 35.4% of supply, with visible public keys on 10 November 2026, up from 6.04 million BTC (30.2%) in May 2026. Most of it is due to address reuse.

Bitcoin developers are already discussing solutions, such as the BIP-360 draft that proposes a new output format. But it is still a draft and nothing has been decided. For coins whose owners are inactive or whose keys are lost, possibly including Satoshi's coins, they cannot be moved to a safer format unless there is a protocol change that would likely be contentious.
why_en: Satoshi's coins represent about 5% of the maximum supply of 21 million BTC. If those coins ever move, whether because their owner becomes active again or because of an attack using new technology, the market would likely react strongly. That is why this mystery is still relevant today.
tips_en: Avoid reusing the same Bitcoin address. According to Glassnode, moving coins to a fresh address ends the public-key exposure caused by address reuse.
Be wary of anyone claiming to be Satoshi or selling "Satoshi coins". Claims like these have repeatedly proven false.
The quantum threat is still theoretical for now. Don't panic, but follow developments from official Bitcoin developer sources.
analysis_en: The factual parts of this article are based on public records, on-chain research and a court ruling. The theory part about Satoshi's identity is only speculation that has never been proven, and everyone named has denied it. The 1.1 million BTC estimate is also not an exact figure.

title: Edukasi: Kenapa suku bunga The Fed dan yield obligasi AS yang naik bisa menekan crypto, saham, dan rupiah?
summary: Belakangan ini berita crypto sering dibuka dengan kata "The Fed", "CPI", dan "yield 10 tahun". Apa hubungannya dengan harga Bitcoin dan kurs rupiah? Ini penjelasan sederhana soal suku bunga, yield obligasi, dan cara keduanya memengaruhi aset berisiko, lengkap dengan batasannya.
key_points: Suku bunga acuan The Fed (fed funds rate) adalah "harga uang" di AS. Menurut Presiden Dallas Fed Lorie Logan, levelnya saat ini 3,88%.

Yield obligasi adalah imbal hasil yang didapat pemegang surat utang. Harga obligasi lama dan suku bunga bergerak berlawanan: saat bunga naik, obligasi baru lebih menarik dan obligasi lama harus dijual dengan diskon (Investor.gov).
Saat aset "aman" seperti obligasi pemerintah AS memberi imbal hasil sekitar 5%, aset tanpa imbal hasil seperti Bitcoin dan emas jadi relatif kurang menarik bagi sebagian investor.
Bunga dan yield AS yang naik biasanya memperkuat dolar, sehingga mata uang negara berkembang seperti rupiah ikut tertekan.

IMF (2022): korelasi return harian Bitcoin dengan indeks saham S&P 500 naik dari 0,01 (2017-2019) menjadi 0,36 (2020-2021). Artinya crypto makin sering bergerak searah saham, tapi hubungan ini tidak selalu tetap.
body: Apa itu suku bunga The Fed? Federal Reserve (The Fed), bank sentral AS, menetapkan kisaran target suku bunga federal funds lewat rapat Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). Suku bunga ini memengaruhi bunga pinjaman bank, kartu kredit, KPR, sampai imbal hasil obligasi. Dalam pidatonya 10 November 2026, Presiden Dallas Fed Lorie Logan menyebut fed funds rate saat ini 3,88%, dan menilai perlu setidaknya dua kali lagi kenaikan 25 basis poin. Rapat FOMC berikutnya dijadwalkan 8-9 Desember.

Apa itu yield obligasi? Obligasi adalah surat utang. Pemerintah AS menerbitkan Treasury: T-bills (jatuh tempo hingga 52 minggu), notes (hingga 10 tahun), dan bonds (umumnya 30 tahun). Yield adalah imbal hasil yang didapat pemegangnya. Menurut Investor.gov milik SEC, kenaikan suku bunga membuat obligasi baru lebih menarik karena bunganya lebih tinggi, sehingga obligasi lama dengan bunga rendah mungkin harus dijual dengan diskon. Karena itu harga obligasi dan yield bergerak berlawanan arah. Yield Treasury 10 tahun sering dipakai sebagai patokan biaya uang global. Pada 10 November 2026, menurut CNBC, yield ini sempat di atas 5% setelah data inflasi AS keluar lebih panas dari perkiraan.

Kenapa ini bisa menekan crypto? Ada beberapa jalur yang sering dibahas analis. Pertama, biaya peluang: jika obligasi pemerintah AS, yang dianggap paling aman, sudah memberi sekitar 5% per tahun, sebagian investor jadi kurang tertarik memegang aset yang tidak memberi imbal hasil seperti Bitcoin atau emas. Kedua, likuiditas: bunga tinggi membuat pinjaman lebih mahal, termasuk untuk trading dengan leverage, sehingga uang spekulatif cenderung berkurang. Ketiga, korelasi dengan saham: menurut analisis IMF yang terbit Januari 2022, korelasi return harian Bitcoin dengan S&P 500 hanya 0,01 pada 2017-2019, tetapi naik menjadi 0,36 pada 2020-2021. Saat saham teknologi tertekan oleh bunga tinggi, crypto lebih sering ikut turun.

Lalu apa hubungannya dengan rupiah? Bunga dan yield AS yang lebih tinggi menarik modal ke aset dolar, sehingga dolar cenderung menguat terhadap mata uang negara berkembang. CNBC Indonesia pada 11 November menulis bahwa pandangan The Fed yang hawkish dan inflasi AS yang lebih tinggi dari ekspektasi menjadi ancaman bagi IHSG dan rupiah, karena keduanya sudah membuat indeks dolar dan yield Treasury naik. Pada awal perdagangan 11 November, menurut Liputan6, dolar AS menyentuh Rp18.113.

Penting diingat: ini bukan hukum pasti. Harga crypto juga dipengaruhi faktor lain seperti arus dana ETF, regulasi, kejadian peretasan, dan sentimen. Korelasi dengan saham bisa naik atau turun dari waktu ke waktu, dan pasar sering sudah "memperhitungkan" kenaikan bunga sebelum benar-benar terjadi. Jadi data makro sebaiknya dipakai sebagai salah satu konteks, bukan satu-satunya alasan membeli atau menjual.
why_it_matters: Investor crypto di Indonesia terkena dua kali dampak kebijakan The Fed: lewat harga crypto dalam dolar dan lewat kurs rupiah. Memahami mekanismenya membantu membaca kenapa pasar bisa bergerak tajam di hari rilis data seperti CPI atau keputusan FOMC.
tips: Tandai kalender: rilis CPI dan PCE AS, serta rapat FOMC (berikutnya 8-9 Desember). Volatilitas sering naik di sekitar jadwal ini.
Hindari leverage berlebihan menjelang rilis data makro besar; pergerakan tajam bisa memicu likuidasi.
Pantau yield Treasury 10 tahun dan indeks dolar sebagai konteks, bukan sinyal beli atau jual.
Ingat dampak kurs: nilai aset crypto dalam rupiah dipengaruhi harga dalam dolar dan kurs USD/IDR.
analysis: Penjelasan di atas adalah mekanisme umum yang banyak dipakai ekonom dan analis pasar, bukan prediksi. Angka korelasi dari IMF berlaku untuk periode yang diteliti (2017-2021) dan bisa berbeda di periode lain.

title_en: Learn: Why rising Fed rates and US bond yields can weigh on crypto, stocks and the rupiah
summary_en: Lately, crypto news often opens with the words "the Fed", "CPI" and "10-year yield". What do they have to do with the Bitcoin price and the rupiah exchange rate? Here is a simple explanation of interest rates, bond yields and how both affect risk assets, including their limits.
key_points_en: The Fed's policy rate (fed funds rate) is the "price of money" in the US. According to Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, it currently stands at 3.88%.

A bond yield is the return a debt holder receives. Prices of existing bonds and interest rates move in opposite directions: when rates rise, new bonds are more appealing and older bonds have to be sold at a discount (Investor.gov).
When "safe" assets such as US government bonds yield around 5%, non-yielding assets such as Bitcoin and gold become relatively less attractive to some investors.
Rising US rates and yields usually strengthen the dollar, so emerging market currencies such as the rupiah come under pressure too.

IMF (2022): the correlation of Bitcoin's daily returns with the S&P 500 stock index rose from 0.01 (2017-2019) to 0.36 (2020-2021). That means crypto moves in the same direction as stocks more often, but this relationship is not fixed.
body_en: What is the Fed's interest rate? The Federal Reserve (the Fed), the US central bank, sets the target range for the federal funds rate at meetings of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC). This rate affects bank lending rates, credit cards, mortgages and even bond yields. In a speech on 10 November 2026, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said the fed funds rate currently stands at 3.88% and that at least two more 25 basis point hikes are needed. The next FOMC meeting is scheduled for 8-9 December.

What is a bond yield? A bond is a debt security. The US government issues Treasuries: T-bills (maturing in up to 52 weeks), notes (up to 10 years) and bonds (typically 30 years). The yield is the return its holder receives. According to the SEC's Investor.gov, rising interest rates make newly issued bonds more appealing because they pay higher interest, so older bonds with lower rates may have to be sold at a discount. That is why bond prices and yields move in opposite directions. The 10-year Treasury yield is often used as a benchmark for the global cost of money. On 10 November 2026, according to CNBC, this yield briefly topped 5% after US inflation data came in hotter than expected.

Why can this weigh on crypto? There are several channels analysts often discuss. First, opportunity cost: if US government bonds, considered the safest, already pay about 5% a year, some investors become less interested in holding assets that pay no yield, such as Bitcoin or gold. Second, liquidity: high rates make borrowing more expensive, including for leveraged trading, so speculative money tends to shrink. Third, correlation with stocks: according to an IMF analysis published in January 2022, the correlation of Bitcoin's daily returns with the S&P 500 was only 0.01 in 2017-2019 but rose to 0.36 in 2020-2021. When tech stocks are pressured by high rates, crypto falls with them more often.

What does this have to do with the rupiah? Higher US rates and yields attract capital into dollar assets, so the dollar tends to strengthen against emerging market currencies. CNBC Indonesia wrote on 11 November that the Fed's hawkish views and higher-than-expected US inflation pose a threat to the JCI (IHSG) and the rupiah, because both have already pushed up the dollar index and Treasury yields. In early trading on 11 November, according to Liputan6, the US dollar touched Rp18,113.

Important to remember: this is not a fixed law. Crypto prices are also affected by other factors such as ETF flows, regulation, hacks and sentiment. The correlation with stocks can rise or fall over time, and markets often "price in" rate hikes before they actually happen. So macro data is best used as one piece of context, not the only reason to buy or sell.
why_en: Crypto investors in Indonesia are hit twice by Fed policy: through crypto prices in dollars and through the rupiah exchange rate. Understanding the mechanism helps explain why markets can move sharply on data release days such as CPI or FOMC decisions.
tips_en: Mark your calendar: US CPI and PCE releases, and FOMC meetings (next on 8-9 December). Volatility often rises around these dates.
Avoid excessive leverage ahead of major macro data releases; sharp moves can trigger liquidations.
Watch the 10-year Treasury yield and the dollar index as context, not as buy or sell signals.
Remember the currency effect: the rupiah value of crypto assets depends on both the dollar price and the USD/IDR exchange rate.
analysis_en: The explanation above is a general mechanism widely used by economists and market analysts, not a prediction. The IMF correlation figures apply to the period studied (2017-2021) and may differ in other periods.

title: Sejarah & fakta: Hampir 25 tahun uang euro, operasi ganti uang tunai terbesar di dunia, dan kini bersiap ke digital euro
summary: Pada 1 Januari 2002, 308 juta orang di 12 negara Eropa bangun dengan uang baru di dompet. ECB menyebutnya pergantian mata uang terbesar yang pernah ada. Menjelang ulang tahun ke-25 uang kertas dan koin euro, ini fakta-fakta menarik soal bagaimana operasi raksasa itu dijalankan, dan apa hubungannya dengan rencana digital euro.
key_points: Euro diluncurkan 1 Januari 1999, tetapi tiga tahun pertama hanya berupa "uang tak terlihat" untuk akuntansi dan pembayaran elektronik. Uang tunainya baru beredar 1 Januari 2002 (ECB).
Pergantian 2002 melibatkan 12 negara dengan total penduduk 308 juta orang; ECB menyebutnya pergantian mata uang terbesar di dunia.
Sebanyak 14,89 miliar lembar uang kertas senilai sekitar €633 miliar dicetak di 15 percetakan. Jika dijajarkan, panjangnya cukup untuk ke Bulan dan kembali dua setengah kali (ECB).
Sekitar 52 miliar koin senilai €15,75 miliar dibuat oleh 16 percetakan uang Eropa, memakai 250.000 ton logam.
Kini euro adalah alat pembayaran sah di 21 dari 27 negara Uni Eropa (Bulgaria bergabung 2026), dipakai sekitar 358 juta orang. ECB menyiapkan pilot digital euro mulai semester II 2027.
body: Euro tidak lahir sebagai uang tunai. Menurut Bank Sentral Eropa (ECB), euro diluncurkan pada 1 Januari 1999 dan saat itu menjadi mata uang lebih dari 300 juta orang di Eropa. Namun selama tiga tahun pertama, euro adalah mata uang "tak terlihat" yang hanya dipakai untuk keperluan akuntansi, misalnya pembayaran elektronik. Uang kertas dan koin euro baru diperkenalkan pada 1 Januari 2002, menggantikan uang nasional seperti franc Belgia dan Deutsche Mark dengan kurs konversi tetap.

Skala operasinya luar biasa. ECB mencatat, pada 1 Januari 2002 uang kertas dan koin euro diperkenalkan di 12 negara dengan total penduduk 308 juta orang, dan menyebutnya "the world's largest ever monetary changeover" (pergantian mata uang terbesar yang pernah ada di dunia). Produksi uang kertas sudah dimulai sejak Juli 1999 di 15 percetakan uang di seluruh Uni Eropa. Hingga 1 Januari 2002, tercetak 14,89 miliar lembar dengan nilai nominal sekitar €633 miliar. Menurut ECB, jika dijajarkan ujung ke ujung, uang kertas itu cukup untuk mencapai Bulan dan kembali dua setengah kali.

Untuk koin, sekitar 52 miliar keping senilai €15,75 miliar diproduksi oleh 16 percetakan uang Eropa dengan 250.000 ton logam. Dalam pidato tahun 2003, pejabat ECB menggambarkan bahwa dibutuhkan sekitar 10.000 truk untuk mengangkut seluruh koin itu. Pecahan yang paling banyak dicetak adalah €20 (3,406 miliar lembar), sedangkan €200 paling sedikit (223 juta lembar).

Kuncinya adalah distribusi lebih awal (frontloading). Uang euro sudah dikirim ke bank dan peritel sejak September 2001. Menurut ECB, sebelum 1 Januari 2002 sekitar 6,4 miliar lembar uang kertas senilai sekitar €133 miliar dan 37,5 miliar koin sudah didistribusikan lebih dulu. Warga juga bisa membeli "starter kit", kantong berisi koin euro, dan 150 juta starter kit terjual dalam dua minggu.

Hasilnya cepat. Pada 3 Januari 2002, 96% mesin ATM di kawasan euro sudah mengeluarkan uang euro. Seminggu setelah peluncuran, lebih dari separuh transaksi tunai sudah memakai euro. Setelah masa peredaran ganda yang di beberapa negara berlangsung hingga dua bulan, euro menjadi satu-satunya alat pembayaran sah di kawasan euro pada 1 Maret 2002. Saat itu lebih dari 6 miliar lembar uang kertas dan hampir 30 miliar koin nasional sudah ditarik.

Fakta kecil yang menarik: kurs konversi tetap 1 euro = 1,95583 Deutsche Mark, dan angka yang sama persis berlaku untuk lev Bulgaria (1 euro = 1,95583 lev) saat Bulgaria masuk euro pada 2026. Sementara 1 euro setara 1.936,27 lira Italia. Saat ini, menurut ECB, uang euro adalah alat pembayaran sah di 21 dari 27 negara anggota Uni Eropa dan dipakai sekitar 358 juta orang.

Babak berikutnya adalah digital. Dalam pidato di Parlemen Eropa pada 10 November 2026, anggota Dewan Eksekutif ECB Piero Cipollone mengatakan pilot digital euro akan dimulai pada semester II 2027 dengan versi beta tanpa status alat pembayaran sah, dan tanggal penerbitan pertama baru bisa ditetapkan setelah regulasinya disahkan. ECB juga sedang mendesain ulang uang kertas euro; survei desainnya diikuti hampir 10 juta responden, dan pecahan pertama seri baru diperkirakan beredar awal 2030-an. Digital euro berbeda dari crypto seperti Bitcoin: ia akan diterbitkan dan dijamin bank sentral, bukan jaringan terdesentralisasi.
why_it_matters: Pergantian euro 2002 menunjukkan bahwa uang pada dasarnya adalah kesepakatan dan infrastruktur: mencetak, mendistribusikan, dan membuat orang percaya. Memahami sejarah ini membantu melihat konteks perdebatan masa kini soal digital euro, stablecoin, dan crypto, yang semuanya bersaing menjadi bentuk uang berikutnya.
tips: 1 Januari 1999: euro lahir sebagai uang elektronik/akuntansi di 11 negara pendiri.
1 Januari 2002: uang tunai euro beredar di 12 negara (Yunani masuk euro pada 2001).
1 Maret 2002: euro menjadi satu-satunya alat pembayaran sah di kawasan euro.
1 Januari 2026: Bulgaria menjadi anggota ke-21 kawasan euro.
Semester II 2027: rencana pilot digital euro (versi beta, belum alat pembayaran sah).
analysis: Bagian sejarah di atas mengikuti data resmi ECB. Perbandingan digital euro dengan crypto adalah penjelasan umum; desain final digital euro masih menunggu regulasi Uni Eropa.

title_en: History & facts: Nearly 25 years of euro cash, the world's biggest currency changeover, and now preparing for the digital euro
summary_en: On 1 January 2002, 308 million people in 12 European countries woke up with new money in their wallets. The ECB calls it the largest currency changeover ever. Ahead of the 25th anniversary of euro banknotes and coins, here are interesting facts about how that giant operation was run, and how it relates to the digital euro plan.
key_points_en: The euro was launched on 1 January 1999, but for its first three years it was an "invisible currency" used only for accounting and electronic payments. Cash only entered circulation on 1 January 2002 (ECB).
The 2002 changeover involved 12 countries with a total population of 308 million; the ECB calls it the world's largest ever monetary changeover.
14.89 billion banknotes worth about €633 billion were printed at 15 printing works. Placed end to end, they would reach the moon and back two and a half times (ECB).
Around 52 billion coins worth €15.75 billion were made by 16 European mints, using 250,000 tonnes of metal.
Today the euro is legal tender in 21 of the 27 EU member states (Bulgaria joined in 2026), used by about 358 million people. The ECB is preparing a digital euro pilot from the second half of 2027.
body_en: The euro was not born as cash. According to the European Central Bank (ECB), the euro was launched on 1 January 1999, when it became the currency of more than 300 million people in Europe. But for the first three years it was an "invisible" currency, used only for accounting purposes such as electronic payments. Euro banknotes and coins were only introduced on 1 January 2002, replacing national currencies such as the Belgian franc and the Deutsche Mark at fixed conversion rates.

The scale of the operation was extraordinary. The ECB notes that on 1 January 2002 euro banknotes and coins were introduced in 12 countries with a total population of 308 million, calling it "the world's largest ever monetary changeover". Banknote production had started in July 1999 at 15 printing works across the EU. By 1 January 2002, 14.89 billion banknotes had been printed with a total face value of about €633 billion. According to the ECB, placed end to end, those banknotes would have reached the moon and back two and a half times.

For coins, around 52 billion pieces worth €15.75 billion were produced by 16 European mints using 250,000 tonnes of metal. In a 2003 speech, an ECB official illustrated that about 10,000 trucks would be needed to transport all those coins. The most-printed denomination was the €20 (3.406 billion notes), while the €200 was the least (223 million notes).

The key was early distribution (frontloading). Euro cash was delivered to banks and retailers from September 2001. According to the ECB, before 1 January 2002 about 6.4 billion banknotes worth some €133 billion and 37.5 billion coins had already been frontloaded. Citizens could also buy "starter kits", bags of euro coins, and 150 million starter kits were sold in two weeks.

The results came fast. By 3 January 2002, 96% of cash dispensers in the euro area were issuing euro banknotes. One week after the launch, more than half of all cash transactions were in euro. After a dual circulation period that lasted up to two months in some countries, the euro became the sole legal tender in the euro area on 1 March 2002. By then, more than 6 billion banknotes and close to 30 billion national coins had been withdrawn.

A small but interesting fact: the fixed conversion rate was 1 euro = 1.95583 Deutsche Mark, and exactly the same figure applies to the Bulgarian lev (1 euro = 1.95583 lev) when Bulgaria joined the euro in 2026. Meanwhile, 1 euro equals 1,936.27 Italian lire. Today, according to the ECB, euro cash is legal tender in 21 of the 27 EU member states and used by about 358 million people.

The next chapter is digital. In a speech at the European Parliament on 10 November 2026, ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said the digital euro pilot will start in the second half of 2027 with a beta version without legal tender status, and that the first issuance date can only be set after the regulation is adopted. The ECB is also redesigning euro banknotes; its design survey drew almost 10 million responses, and the first denominations of the new series are expected to circulate in the early 2030s. The digital euro differs from crypto such as Bitcoin: it would be issued and backed by the central bank, not a decentralized network.
why_en: The 2002 euro changeover shows that money is fundamentally agreement and infrastructure: printing, distributing and getting people to trust it. Understanding this history helps put today's debates about the digital euro, stablecoins and crypto into context, as they all compete to become the next form of money.
tips_en: 1 January 1999: the euro is born as electronic/accounting money in 11 founding countries.
1 January 2002: euro cash enters circulation in 12 countries (Greece joined the euro in 2001).
1 March 2002: the euro becomes the sole legal tender in the euro area.
1 January 2026: Bulgaria becomes the 21st euro area member.
Second half of 2027: planned digital euro pilot (beta version, not yet legal tender).
analysis_en: The history above follows official ECB data. The comparison between the digital euro and crypto is a general explanation; the digital euro's final design still awaits EU legislation.

title: Edukasi: Apa itu saham tokenisasi dan perpetual saham? Bedanya, cara kerjanya, dan risikonya
summary: Saham AS versi token akan diperdagangkan 24/7 di blockchain, sementara perpetual futures saham sedang diperebutkan di pengadilan AS. Keduanya sama-sama "saham di dunia crypto", tapi isinya sangat berbeda. Ini penjelasan sederhana berdasarkan dokumen resmi SEC dan pengadilan.
key_points: Saham tokenisasi adalah efek (misalnya saham) yang dicatat atau diwakili dalam bentuk aset crypto di blockchain. Menurut staf SEC, formatnya tidak mengubah status hukumnya: saham tetap saham.

Staf SEC membagi model tokenisasi menjadi dua: dibuat oleh emiten sendiri, atau dibuat pihak ketiga. Model pihak ketiga ada dua jenis: kustodian (token mewakili saham asli yang disimpan) dan sintetis (token hanya memberi eksposur harga).
Perpetual futures (perp) adalah kontrak derivatif tanpa tanggal jatuh tempo. Pemegangnya tidak memiliki saham, hanya bertaruh pada naik-turunnya harga, sering dengan leverage.

"Innovation exemption" SEC (17 Sep 2026) mengizinkan venue khusus memperdagangkan saham tokenisasi lewat AMM, dengan syarat antara lain hak pemegang token sama dengan saham biasa dan emiten bisa menolak jika tokenisasi dilakukan pihak ketiga.
Pada 3 Nov 2026, seorang hakim federal AS menilai perpetual saham kemungkinan bukan "security future" melainkan swap yang diatur SEC, sehingga status hukumnya di AS masih diperdebatkan.
body: Belakangan istilah "saham tokenisasi" makin sering muncul. Contoh terbarunya, OKXICE, perusahaan patungan OKX dan induk NYSE, akan memperdagangkan saham AS versi token mulai 23 November. Di saat yang sama, ada produk lain yang juga "berbau saham" di dunia crypto: perpetual futures saham. Keduanya sering disamakan, padahal sangat berbeda.

Mulai dari definisinya. Dalam pernyataan staf tiga divisi SEC tanggal 28 Januari 2026, tokenized security didefinisikan sebagai instrumen keuangan yang termasuk "efek" menurut hukum AS, yang diformat sebagai atau diwakili oleh aset crypto, dengan catatan kepemilikan disimpan sebagian atau seluruhnya di jaringan crypto. Staf SEC menegaskan bahwa format tidak mengubah penerapan hukum sekuritas: saham tetap dianggap saham, apa pun bentuknya.

Menurut staf SEC, ada dua kategori besar. Pertama, saham yang ditokenisasi oleh emiten sendiri (atau agennya), misalnya ketika daftar pemegang saham resmi perusahaan dicatat langsung di blockchain. Kedua, saham yang ditokenisasi oleh pihak ketiga yang tidak terafiliasi dengan emiten. Kategori kedua ini dibagi lagi: model kustodian, di mana saham asli disimpan oleh kustodian dan token membuktikan kepemilikan atas saham itu; dan model sintetis, di mana pihak ketiga menerbitkan efeknya sendiri yang hanya memberi eksposur harga, misalnya linked security atau security-based swap. Staf SEC mengingatkan bahwa pada model pihak ketiga, pemegang token bisa terkena risiko terkait pihak ketiga tersebut, seperti kebangkrutan, yang tidak dialami pemegang saham biasa.

Lalu bagaimana saham tokenisasi diperdagangkan? Pada 17 September 2026, SEC mengeluarkan "Innovation Exemption", pengecualian sementara yang mengizinkan Tokenized Securities Venue (TSV) memperdagangkan saham tokenisasi lewat automated market maker (AMM) dan pool likuiditas. Syaratnya antara lain: jumlah simbol dan volume dibatasi, token harus memberi hak yang sama dengan saham biasa di kelas yang setara, emiten harus diberi pemberitahuan dan kesempatan menolak jika tokenisasi dilakukan pihak ketiga, smart contract harus publik dan bisa diaudit, dan perdagangan token harus berhenti bersamaan dengan penghentian perdagangan saham aslinya di bursa utama. Pengecualian ini berlaku lima tahun.

Perpetual futures berbeda total. Ini adalah kontrak derivatif yang tidak punya tanggal jatuh tempo. Pemegang kontrak tidak memiliki saham dan tidak mendapat dividen atau hak suara; ia hanya mendapat untung atau rugi dari pergerakan harga. Di pasar crypto, perp biasanya memakai mekanisme funding rate, yaitu pembayaran berkala antara pihak long dan short, dan sering dipakai dengan leverage, sehingga posisi bisa dilikuidasi jika harga bergerak berlawanan.

Status perp saham di AS sedang diuji di pengadilan. Dalam perkara Capital Markets Alliance Association v. CFTC, hakim Valerie Caproni pada 3 November 2026 menolak permohonan perintah darurat, tetapi menilai penggugat kemungkinan besar benar bahwa kontrak perpetual atas saham tunggal tidak memenuhi definisi security future, karena tidak menjanjikan penyerahan saham di tanggal tertentu, dan lebih tampak sebagai swap yang diatur SEC. Perkara ini masih berjalan, dan SEC ikut mengajukan amicus brief pada 9 November.
why_it_matters: Semakin banyak platform crypto menawarkan "saham" dalam berbagai bentuk. Memahami bedanya membantu kamu tahu apa yang sebenarnya kamu pegang: saham asli dengan hak dividen, token yang bergantung pada pihak ketiga, atau sekadar kontrak taruhan harga dengan leverage.
tips: Tanyakan: apakah token ini didukung saham asli (1:1) atau hanya eksposur harga (sintetis/derivatif)?
Cek hak yang kamu dapat: dividen, hak suara, dan corporate action. Perp tidak memberi hak-hak ini.
Kenali pihak penerbit dan kustodiannya, karena ada risiko pihak ketiga seperti kebangkrutan.
Cek apakah produk itu memang tersedia untuk negaramu. OKXICE, misalnya, awalnya hanya untuk nasabah di AS.
Untuk pengguna Indonesia, pakai platform yang terdaftar dan diawasi OJK, dan hati-hati memakai leverage.
analysis: Saham tokenisasi dan perp saham sama-sama membawa pasar saham ke jam 24/7 ala crypto, tetapi risikonya berbeda: saham tokenisasi model kustodian paling mirip memegang saham asli, sedangkan perp adalah instrumen spekulasi dengan leverage. Aturan di AS juga masih bergerak, jadi produk yang ada hari ini bisa berubah. Ini edukasi, bukan saran investasi.

title_en: Explainer: What are tokenized stocks and stock perpetuals? The differences, how they work, and the risks
summary_en: Tokenized US stocks are set to trade 24/7 on blockchain, while single-stock perpetual futures are being fought over in a US court. Both are "stocks in the crypto world", but they are very different. Here is a simple explanation based on official SEC and court documents.
key_points_en: A tokenized stock is a security (for example a share) recorded or represented as a crypto asset on a blockchain. According to SEC staff, the format does not change its legal status: a stock is still a stock.

SEC staff divide tokenization models into two: created by the issuer itself, or created by a third party. Third-party models come in two types: custodial (the token represents a real share held in custody) and synthetic (the token only provides price exposure).
Perpetual futures (perps) are derivative contracts with no expiry date. Holders do not own the stock; they only bet on price moves, often with leverage.

The SEC's "innovation exemption" (17 Sep 2026) allows special venues to trade tokenized stocks through AMMs, on conditions including that token holders have the same rights as ordinary shareholders and that issuers can object if tokenization is done by a third party.
On 3 Nov 2026, a US federal judge found that stock perpetuals are likely not a "security future" but a swap regulated by the SEC, so their legal status in the US is still contested.
body_en: Lately the term "tokenized stocks" has been showing up more often. The latest example is OKXICE, the joint venture of OKX and NYSE's parent, which will trade tokenized US stocks from 23 November. At the same time, there is another "stock-like" product in the crypto world: single-stock perpetual futures. The two are often lumped together, yet they are very different.

Start with the definition. In a staff statement from three SEC divisions dated 28 January 2026, a tokenized security is defined as a financial instrument that is a "security" under US law, formatted as or represented by a crypto asset, with ownership records kept in whole or in part on a crypto network. SEC staff stress that the format does not change how securities law applies: a stock is still treated as a stock, whatever its form.

According to SEC staff, there are two broad categories. First, stocks tokenized by the issuer itself (or its agent), for example when the company's official shareholder register is recorded directly on a blockchain. Second, stocks tokenized by a third party not affiliated with the issuer. This second category is split further: the custodial model, where the real share is held by a custodian and the token evidences ownership of that share; and the synthetic model, where the third party issues its own security that only provides price exposure, such as a linked security or a security-based swap. SEC staff warn that in third-party models, token holders may be exposed to risks related to that third party, such as bankruptcy, which ordinary shareholders would not face.

So how are tokenized stocks traded? On 17 September 2026, the SEC issued the "Innovation Exemption", a temporary exemption allowing Tokenized Securities Venues (TSVs) to trade tokenized stocks through automated market makers (AMMs) and liquidity pools. Conditions include: limits on the number of symbols and volume, tokens must give the same rights as ordinary shares of an equivalent class, issuers must be given notice and a chance to object if tokenization is done by a third party, smart contracts must be public and auditable, and token trading must stop whenever trading in the underlying stock stops on the primary listing exchange. The exemption lasts five years.

Perpetual futures are completely different. They are derivative contracts with no expiry date. Contract holders do not own the stock and receive no dividends or voting rights; they only make a profit or loss from price moves. In crypto markets, perps usually use a funding rate mechanism, periodic payments between longs and shorts, and are often used with leverage, so positions can be liquidated if the price moves against them.

The status of stock perps in the US is being tested in court. In Capital Markets Alliance Association v. CFTC, Judge Valerie Caproni on 3 November 2026 denied an emergency order request, but found the plaintiff likely right that perpetual contracts on single stocks do not meet the definition of a security future, because they do not provide for delivery of the stock on a set date, and appear instead to be swaps regulated by the SEC. The case is ongoing, and the SEC filed an amicus brief on 9 November.
why_en: More and more crypto platforms are offering "stocks" in various forms. Understanding the differences helps you know what you actually hold: a real share with dividend rights, a token that depends on a third party, or just a leveraged price-betting contract.
tips_en: Ask: is this token backed by a real share (1:1) or does it only give price exposure (synthetic/derivative)?
Check the rights you get: dividends, voting rights and corporate actions. Perps do not give these rights.
Know the issuer and custodian, because there are third-party risks such as bankruptcy.
Check whether the product is actually available in your country. OKXICE, for example, is initially only for US customers.
For users in Indonesia, use platforms registered with and supervised by OJK, and be careful with leverage.
analysis_en: Tokenized stocks and stock perps both bring the stock market into crypto-style 24/7 hours, but their risks differ: custodial tokenized stocks are closest to holding a real share, while perps are speculative instruments with leverage. US rules are also still moving, so products that exist today may change. This is education, not investment advice.
